verdict.rationale: Secureframe's own docs say it automates manual evidence collection through 100+ integrations. Automated control testing collects compliance evidence from integrated technologies, and continuous daily monitoring implies a recurring schedule rather than one-off pulls. Nothing documents that the collected artifacts are timestamped or how they are retained and presented to auditors. missing for 10: documentation of timestamped evidence artifacts, explicit evidence-collection schedule configuration (beyond daily test monitoring), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, evidence is collected automatically from connected systems on a schedule — screenshots and CSV exports are replaced by timestamped, machine-gathered artifacts

citations.quote: Automate manual evidence collection utilizing our 100+ integrations
Secureframe seamlessly syncs with hundreds of the tools you're already using to automate evidence collection and continuous monitoring.
automated control testing that collects compliance evidence from integrated technologies
Continuous daily monitoring of your compliance status with alerts for failing tests.
